candidates.snippet:

## 改了什么

- **方案卡（新 MCP 工具 `offer_choices`）**：AI 发 2~4 个方案，可以带截图。卡片在对话正文里并排显示，你点一个，可以补一句，点「选 N 发送」，卡片就替你发一条消息给 AI。也可以选「都不要」。缩略图看不清就点放大，在大图里左右翻方案，也能直接选。选完卡片收成一行，记下你选了什么；重新打开旧会话也认得出来。五家 AI 都免审批，手机上改成横滑。
- **Claude 提问卡显示选项预览**：Claude 的 AskUserQuestion 选项可以带一段预览（ASCII 草图、代码片段），以前被我们丢掉了，现在鼠标指到哪个选项就显示它的预览。
- **选中一段点「引用」**：在 AI 回复里选中文字，旁边出现「引用」，这段以 `> ` 引用块进输入框。可以连引几段，中间夹自己的话。引用时对话区不滚动，你读到哪里就停在哪里。
- **长回复目录**：写完的长回复（1200 字以上、至少两个小标题）右上角有一个目录钮，点开列出小标题，点哪个跳到哪个。
- **超长代码块收起**：超过 30 行的代码块默认只露 18 行，底部是「展开全部 N 行」。复制

candidates.author: everforward
candidates.title: You can do the "almost-realtime" part, all locally.
candidates.snippet: You can do the "almost-realtime" part, all locally. I tinkered with a Python script for a few hours that used Whisper to speech-to-text, fed that into a local Mistral model (don't recall which), and then piped the output into text-to-speech. It wasn't really streamed, though. Audio input was buffered, fully evaluated to a string, then fed into the LLM and the full text was converted back to audio. The Whisper speech-to-text was pretty real-time, the LLM was not. I was barely scraping by on hardware specs, though.
candidates.problem: Need for near real-time, offline speech-to-text, LLM processing, and text-to-speech pipeline with low latency and privacy constraints
candidates.selfBuiltSolution: Created a Python script that buffers audio, uses Whisper for real-time speech-to-text, feeds the transcript to a locally run Mistral LLM, then pipes the LLM output to a TTS engine, all running on limited hardware
candidates.reasoning: The author demonstrates a concrete, self‑built local AI workflow addressing a professional need that most users still rely on cloud services for.
